descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B19 · P1 · 已知

保留 / 清理没有按 UAT 3.6 实现：13 小时的重点事项、37 小时的任务 / 交接 / 体征都还在；医生不打开 app 就不清；超过 500 个病人时会漏清

票：TFA-94699 in progress · 算 QA bug：否（票在做） · 在哪发现：本地

注：一个根因让 19 条用例都挂了；保留时长本身怎么定，见待决策 D6

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-13/S16, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

思路 / Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S21 「查房前文字保留 12 h 且是配置值：窗口从哪来，然后两个模式 11 h 保留 / 13 h 清掉，包括摘要失败留下的文字」 Pre-round text kept 12 h as a configuration value: the window's source, then 11 h kept / 13 h cleared in both modes, including text left by a failed summary

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U13 Pre-round text is kept 12 h in both Hospital and Nursing Home, as a configuration value, not hard-coded.（UAT 3.6）
  • U12 Time rules that Save Note touches ('today' on the course line, today's vitals/labs column, the 12 h window) use the server clock; …（UAT 3.8）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Part 1: convex/lib/lifecycle.ts at e02167f. Part 2: a saved pre-round in each mode, and one left by a failed summary (edited after the last processing)

When Part 1: read where the 12 h pre-round window (both modes) comes from. Part 2: move the server clock to 11 h and to 13 h after the save and let the lifecycle sweep run

Then Part 1: the window is read from the HOSPITAL_RETENTION / Nursing Home retention config objects, not a literal inside the sweep (3.6 'configuration values, not hard-coded'). Part 2: at 11 h the text is there; at 13 h it is gone in both modes, the failed-summary text included

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Part 1: code read against 3.6, can be done now (doc-review). Part 2: human/backend read at each time point against 3.6. Code read: the hospital rule skips text edited after the last processing (risks)

在哪跑：本地 manual（时间 lane，脚本代人做）；测试方法 CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-10.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94699 in progress

结构化摘要失败的预查房文字永远不会被清掉：13 小时、100 小时后医院和养老院的病历上都还在，而正常处理过的文字 13 小时就清了。

Pre-round text whose structured summary failed is never cleared. It is still on the chart at 13 h and at 100 h in both Hospital and Nursing Home, while normally processed text is cleared at 13 h.

依据：allure 831927df: 8 of 19 cells fail. lifecycle.ts clears pre-round text only when preRoundEditedAt <= notesProcessedAt. The lane labels this NEW, but OAT-04 knownGaps K11 already records it (known: TFA-94699 AC 1 / OAT-04 Q2), the unit test 'Hospital never purges unprocessed pre-round dictation' codifies it, and TC-10 risks predicted it. ticket-map says UAT only, so TFA-94699 is listed here through K11. The 100 h cell breaks the 3.7 36 h claim under any reading. Whether the 12 h window covers failed-save text is OAT-04 Q2 (Daniela).

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane manual。

测试方法：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；辅助：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：manual。

UAT item: TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-10/S21

Pre-round text kept 12 h as a configuration value: the window's source, then 11 h kept / 13 h cleared in both modes, including text left by a failed summary

Tickets: none (UAT only)

本地新 lane manual：manual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（manual/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Part 1: code read of convex/lib/lifecycle.ts at e02167f, done inside the spec (test 'part 1' prints the lines). Part 2: api spec, both modes: a saved, processed pre-round (notesProcessedAt = preRoundEditedAt) and a failed-summary pre-round (preRoundError set, notesProcessedAt absent or older than preRoundEditedAt, as useSnfPreRoundProcess / the hospital save write on a failed parse), aged 11 h, 13 h and 100 h (the 100 h cell shows the failed-summary text never ages out); applyLifecycle; read. — Both parts are deterministic: a code read and server reads after aging.

Detail:

11/19 judged cells pass, 1 recorded. Fail: Hospital failed-first-save: text gone at 13 h [U13] | Hospital failed-after-processing: text gone at 13 h [U13] | Hospital failed-first-save: text gone at 100 h [U13] | Hospital failed-after-processing: text gone at 100 h [U13] | Nursing Home failed-first-save: text gone at 13 h [U13] | Nursing Home failed-after-processing: text gone at 13 h [U13] | Nursing Home failed-first-save: text gone at 100 h [U13] | Nursing Home failed-after-processing: text gone at 100 h [U13]. Recorded: Part 1 note: the config objects are module constants = "HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION are constants in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts: lengthening a window is a code change + deploy, not an environ.

产品问题：NEW (U13 has no gate). A pre-round note whose structured summary failed never ages out. The physician saw 'Note saved, but the structured summary couldn't be updated' and walked away. At 13 h, and at 100 h (cell added in the re-run), the typed pre-round text is still on the chart, in Hospital and in Nursing Home. This happens whether the first save failed or a re-save failed after an earlier successful one. A text that was processed normally is cleared at 13 h. Cause: the 12 h rule in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts only fires when preRoundEditedAt ≤ notesProcessedAt, and a failed save leaves preRoundEditedAt newer than notesProcessedAt (or notesProcessedAt missing). Breaks UAT 3.6 ('pre-round text … 12 h', both modes) and TC-10's 'including text left by a failed summary'. Part 1 passes: the window comes from HOSPITAL_RETENTION / SNF_RETENTION, which are code constants.

证据：附了 4 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Part 2 needs the aging helper (shift notesProcessedAt / preRoundEditedAt or the server clock, then run the lifecycle sweep) through the local stack's admin key; dev has no admin key and its server clock cannot be moved, so it stays on the local stack (once the helper exists).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

这个用例别处也有结果（一个用例只显示一个：有结论的优先于卡住，跑过的优先于跳过；同一档取较差的，一样差取先的（dev、dev 的 lane、本地 lane A/C、本地新 lane），测试过时排在通过前面；都是跳过时取 dev 的，除非 dev 只说「本地专用 / dev 上跑不了」或和 lane 同一个原因）：

  • [本地 code-review] 待人看（部分通过）（code-review/results.json） — code-review: partial → 待人看（部分：能查的这半通过，另一半要别的 lane / 人 / 文件 → 待人看） Part 1 passes. The 12 h window is set once per mode in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts: HOSPITAL_RETENTION.preRound = 12 * HOUR (line 9) and SNF_RETENTION.preRound = 12 * HOUR (line 31). The sweeps read it from those objects and not from a literal: hospitalLifecyclePatch at line 122 uses expired(processedAt, HOSPITAL_RETENTION.preRound, no…
